initialization_ancestor.method: winner-only behavior cloning from own-rule self-play; no benchmark examples

recovery_policy.external_runtime: Provision pinned Python/JDK/engine/bridge/benchmark dependencies from main code; compare recorded experiment runtime identities before resuming. No downloaded source, classes, vendor, or virtual environment is included.
recovery_policy.restore: Absent run only; existing progress must be byte-identical. Identity-bound absolute paths are never rewritten. Relocated restoration is stopped for review.
recovery_policy.source_snapshots: Owned source snapshots are historical evidence; never replace current main code automatically.

decision.scope: Precommitted research review rule; no model promotion or all-map victory claim.
